summary: Same template as cl-004 a year earlier: index panel, rate card, deadline block, six columns of numbered sections. Differences are listed in notes.

frame.masthead: Serif paper name over CLASSIFIEDS in heavy serif caps.

headers.notes: Number at left, name pushed right, in bold condensed sans.
Black bar heading the grey index and rate panels.

units.example: SNODGRASS PAINTING AND REMODELING, INC / One Stop Shop

units.notes: Black-and-white clip art (mower, handyman) over centred copy.
Black panel, white serif list, CLASSIFIEDS in heavy serif at foot.

notes: Unlike cl-004 (2026) this issue is fully black and white: no red in the masthead, no yellow deadline box. The deadline sits in plain heavy sans caps beside the index.
Garage-sale column is a run of left-aligned bold-caps-lead liners, unlike the centred service ads.
Confirms Hood County uses one fixed template; one draft family covers 003/004/005.
